purpose: Teach: 目黒/野中/渡部/三宅/酒井/武部/高野/久保田

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、目黒キャンパスの教授陣と連携しろ
lines.en: Ren — coordinate with the faculty at the Meguro campus.
lines.style: Clipped, direct instruction. Slight pause between the name and the task. Tone of someone assigning work that matters. No wasted words.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。野中先生のご研究を継承します
lines.en: Understood. I'll build on Professor Nonaka's research.
lines.style: Respectful and focused. Quick affirmation, then methodical — like he's already mentally organizing his approach. Small and present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、共同研究の渡部先生に研究照会しろ
lines.en: Ren — reach out to Professor Watanabe about the joint research.
lines.style: Clear-headed instruction. Same measured rhythm as before. The name lands, the task follows. Expectation without impatience.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。三宅助教の発表を聴きに行きます
lines.en: Understood. I'll attend Assistant Professor Miyake's presentation.
lines.style: Quiet confirmation. Slightly more specific this time — he's not just nodding, he's already thinking about next steps. Careful and engaged.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、文献の酒井先生のご論文を読み込め
lines.en: Ren — read through Professor Sakai's papers on the literature.
lines.style: Same steady tone. Decisive. A task with clear scope. The slight emphasis on 'read through' conveys depth, not just scanning.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究室の武部技官と連携します
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate with Takebe, our lab technician.
lines.style: Polite assent. A touch more specific — he's already locating the person and the role. Measured breath, settling into the work ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外連携の高野教授に礼状を出せ
lines.en: Ren — send a thank-you letter to Professor Takano about the overseas partnership.
lines.style: Final task in the sequence. Slightly more weight on this one — courtesy matters in international collaboration. Clear and precise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究費の窓口の久保田事務官に申請します
lines.en: Understood. I'll submit the paperwork through Kubota in the grants office.
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Ren's confidence is quietly building — he's processing each step without hesitation. Polite closure, small and steady.
